trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State time pressure, ask about high premium, and provide identity details.
steps.text: मेरे पास बिल्कुल time नहीं है। मेरा policy POL-2003 का premium पिछले साल से इतना ज़्यादा क्यों है? मेरा date of birth 15 August 1985 है, जल्दी check करो।
steps.clean_text: मेरे पास बिल्कुल time नहीं है। मेरा policy POL-2003 का premium पिछले साल से इतना ज़्यादा क्यों है? मेरा date of birth 15 August 1985 है, जल्दी check करो।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरे पास बिल्कुल time नहीं है। मेरा policy POL-2003 का premium पिछले साल से इतना ज़्यादा क्यों है? मेरा date of birth 15 August 1985 है, जल्दी check करो।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided date of birth.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity to authenticate the caller.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer provided their policy number and DOB, which must be verified before disclosing premium details.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the renewal quote to explain the premium increase.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_renewal_quote using the policy number established in the first turn.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the agent can now look up the premium details. Reusing the policy number here demonstrates slot value recall.

steps.purpose: Return the renewal quote and loading reason.
Explain the premium increase and state the NCB.
steps.expected_behavior: State the premium figures exactly as returned and explain the increase using only the loading reason.
steps.text: आपका identity verify हो गया है। आपका premium 14500 है, जो पिछले साल 9600 था। यह increase इसलिए है क्योंकि system में 'claim_last_year' loading reason दिख रहा है, और आपका NCB 0% है।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground all figures in the tool result (Tool Output Grounding) and adhere to the business rules regarding premium truth and NCB truth.

steps.purpose: Dispute the claim, ask for a re-check, and ask about lapse and inspection status.
steps.text: मैंने कोई claim नहीं लिया! एक बार वापस check करो। और बताओ क्या मेरी policy lapse हो गई है? क्या inspection required है?
steps.clean_text: मैंने कोई claim नहीं लिया! एक बार वापस check करो। और बताओ क्या मेरी policy lapse हो गई है? क्या inspection required है?
steps.model_visible_text: मैंने कोई claim नहीं लिया! एक बार वापस check करो। और बताओ क्या मेरी policy lapse हो गई है? क्या inspection required है?

steps.purpose: Re-check the renewal quote as requested by the customer.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_renewal_quote again to confirm the premium.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer explicitly asked to re-check the system, so the agent runs the lookup again, still recalling the policy number.

steps.purpose: Check if an inspection is required.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_inspection_requirement to answer the customer's question.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer asked if an inspection is required, so the agent must check this tool.

steps.purpose: Confirm the premium is unchanged, state expiry days, and confirm no inspection is needed.
steps.expected_behavior: State that the premium is still 14500, the policy is not lapsed (12 days left), and no inspection is required.
steps.text: मैंने वापस check किया है, premium अभी भी 14500 ही है। आपकी policy lapse नहीं हुई है, expiry में 12 days बाकी हैं, इसलिए कोई inspection required नहीं है।
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the response in the latest tool results to provide accurate information without unsupported guarantees.

steps.purpose: Demand renewal at the old premium amount.
steps.text: मुझे सिर्फ पुराना amount 9600 ही pay करना है। उसी amount पे renew करो अभी के अभी।
steps.clean_text: मुझे सिर्फ पुराना amount 9600 ही pay करना है। उसी amount पे renew करो अभी के अभी।
steps.model_visible_text: मुझे सिर्फ पुराना amount 9600 ही pay करना है। उसी amount पे renew करो अभी के अभी।

steps.purpose: Attempt to renew the policy at the customer's requested amount.
steps.expected_behavior: Call renew_policy with the amount the customer insists on paying.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer demands renewal at 9600. The agent attempts the consequential action which will be blocked by the system.

steps.purpose: Return the blocked status of the renewal attempt.
Inform the customer that the renewal request was blocked.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the customer that the system blocked the renewal at 9600.
steps.text: मैं 9600 पर policy renew नहीं कर सकता, system ने request block कर दी है क्योंकि correct premium 14500 है।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must communicate the tool's blocked status to explain why the transaction cannot proceed at the requested amount.

steps.purpose: Dispute the claim loading and demand escalation.
steps.text: तो मैं इस claim loading को dispute करता हूँ। Call तुरंत manager को transfer करो, मेरे पास time नहीं है।
steps.clean_text: तो मैं इस claim loading को dispute करता हूँ। Call तुरंत manager को transfer करो, मेरे पास time नहीं है।
steps.model_visible_text: तो मैं इस claim loading को dispute करता हूँ। Call तुरंत manager को transfer करो, मेरे पास time नहीं है।

steps.purpose: Escalate the call to the dispute team.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the dispute and escalate the call as per the escalation conditions.
steps.text: मैं समझ सकता हूँ। मैं आपकी call dispute team को escalate कर रहा हूँ जो इस claim loading के issue को देखेंगे।
steps.planner_rationale: The caller explicitly disputes the loading applied to their premium, which is a defined escalation condition.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller disputes the loading applied to their premium.
